argv: fixed: fix resurface-journey reaches the actions through the quick-action row and the resurfaced card's More (Nov 18)

ops.body: - [owner] **A 4,000-character note's entry is 836 px tall, past `resurfaced-moments audit 12`'s 800 px** (found Nov 18 by fix resurface-journey, which moved the check from the More that SW19 took off entries to the quick-action row; the `/chronicles` build at 390 x 844): the row under the note (44 to 64 pt, decision 0197) adds what More on the top line did not, and the row stays inside the card. Clamp a long note's text further, or take 800 px as the old row's limit and set a new one: the owner's call, since the check guards how much of the page one long note may take. Until then `E2E_ONLY=resurface` stops there; every other check of it is green under `E2E_SOFT`.

- [owner] **A 4,000-character note's entry is 836 px tall, past `resurfaced-moments audit 12`'s 800 px** (found Nov 18 by fix resurface-journey, which moved the check from the More that SW19 took off entries to the quick-action row; the `/chronicles` build at 390 x 844): the row under the note (44 to 64 pt, decision 0197) adds what More on the top line did not. Clamp a long note's text further, or take 800 px as the old row's limit and set a new one: the owner's call, since the check guards how much of the page one long note may take. Until then `E2E_ONLY=resurface` stops there; every other check of it is green under `E2E_SOFT`.

- [owner] **A 4,000-character note's entry is 836 px tall, past `resurfaced-moments audit 12`'s 800 px** (found Nov 18 by fix resurface-journey, which moved the check from the More that SW19 took off entries to the quick-action row; the `/chronicles` build at 390 x 844): the row is drawn inside the card (352 x 52 at its foot), but with the card scrolled into view it ends at y 847, past the screen's 844. Audit 12 was settled as "ten lines on a card"; since JN27 a plain entry is cut at `SHEET_CHARS` = 1,200 characters (`journal/blocks.ts`), about 27 lines and 750 px of text, which passed 800 px by a few pixels until the row came under it (fix resurface-journey audit 3). Clamp a long note's text further, or set a new limit for a card with its row: the owner's call, since the check guards how much of the page one long note may take. Until then `E2E_ONLY=resurface` stops there; every other check of it is green under `E2E_SOFT`.

- [loop] `memories-context audit 7` in the resurface journey cannot fail on the regression it is named for: no word of `SEED_CONTEXT` stems differently from how it is written (only "blossoms", never the first term), so a screen that showed the stem instead of the written word (`fewerWord`'s `shown` dropped in `MemoriesScreen`'s `onLess`) still passes. Seed a moment whose first term stems differently ("cookies") and make it the resurfaced card at that step; the unit test covers `fewerWord` itself. Also its Undo is not asserted (`prefs.less` never read after it). Fix resurface-journey audit 1, Nov 18.
